content: विप्रकृत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Hurt, offended, injured; एवं विप्रकृते लोके दैत्येन्द्रानुचरैर्मुहुः <ls>Bhāg. 7. 2. 16</ls>. .²2 Insulted, abused, treated with contumely. .²3 Opposed. .²4 Retaliated, requited. .²5 Oppressed, troubled, disturbed. .²6 Irritated, provoked; विप्रकृतः पन्नगः फणां कुरुते <ls>Ś. 6. 31</ls>.
